purpose: Predeclared independent backward-Euler species budget gates for the existing two-step neuron_transport baseline
gates: Each species volume budget closes, including capacity change, advective volume term, linear reactions, volume sources, natural boundary terms and essential-boundary reaction
Each species surface budget closes after replacing advective volume transport by outward surface flux minus the concentration-weighted velocity-divergence integral
The free-row residual L2 passes independently, preventing cancellation of local errors
Previous and current essential boundary coefficients match the static configuration
The two-species baseline has zero net linear-transfer contribution within the zero-reference absolute tolerance

scales.budget: Sum of absolute current and previous capacity inventories divided by dt, reaction and source integrals, gross natural-boundary flux and absolute essential-row reactions. Add the advective volume magnitude for the volume gate, or gross outward/inward advective flux plus the velocity-divergence magnitude for the surface gate
scales.free_rows: Sum of component L2 norms over free rows, with current and previous capacity contributions kept separate before adding advection/reaction/diffusion/source/natural-boundary components
scales.essential_values: L2 norm of prescribed constrained values; zero reference uses the absolute gate

scope: Static body-fitted geometry, prescribed nodal velocity, constant coefficients, backward Euler, scalar fields; SUPG supported for nondiffusive equations. SUPG diffusion is explicitly rejected by this validator. Full native solver and CPU/CUDA field gates remain required.
notes: Essential-boundary exchange is the reaction of the unconstrained weak equations, not a claim that the raw boundary gradient gives the same discrete flux
Advection is nonconservative v dot grad(c); concentration times div(v) must be included when expressing the budget through outward surface flux
Current and previous capacity scales remain separate so a nonzero steady inventory does not become a zero-reference residual test through cancellation
Field integrals are in concentration times physical volume units; they are not automatically kilograms
All database elements are integrated exactly once, independently of their MPI ownership; the validator does not use the production element matrices or PETSc residual
